scenarios.name: two-tenant-lifecycle
scenarios.assertion: Both tenants complete the five-operation lifecycle with overlapping identifiers and distinct state.

scenarios.name: permission-isolation
scenarios.assertion: An unauthorized principal reveals no protected state and causes no mutation.

scenarios.name: service-and-client-restart
scenarios.assertion: A new service process and a new HTTP client reload committed Budget state from PostgreSQL.

scenarios.name: committed-response-loss
scenarios.assertion: A lost post-commit response is recovered by an exact retry after service restart without duplicate history.

scenarios.name: concurrent-replay-and-conflict
scenarios.assertion: Concurrent exact retries share one result, while changed target, operation, or body conflicts without another transition.

scenarios.name: cross-tenant-operation-isolation
scenarios.assertion: A tenant cannot read or mutate an A-only Budget, and the same command UUID starts a distinct tenant-scoped operation rather than replaying A.

scenarios.name: database-unavailable
scenarios.assertion: A paused PostgreSQL database returns one sanitized 503 and never falls back to local state.

scenarios.name: limited-role-denial
scenarios.assertion: The service role cannot read or write private Budget tables.

scenarios.name: startup-refusal
scenarios.assertion: Empty, incompatible, checksum-drifted, and publicly executable databases fail before readiness.
